source.name: Project Hoomans Scene Runtime Adopter Content

translations.EN: That's a horde. We fighting through or pulling back?
translations.TL: Kawan iyan. Lalaban ba tayo o uurong?

translations.EN: That's a lot of them. Fight or fall back?
translations.TL: Ang dami nila. Lalaban o uurong?

translations.EN: That's a lot of them. Stay close—fight or fall back?
translations.TL: Ang dami nila. Dumikit ka—lalaban o uurong?

translations.EN: Horde. Fight or fall back?
translations.TL: Kawan. Laban o urong?

translations.EN: Big group ahead. We decide now: engage or avoid.
translations.TL: Malaking grupo sa harap. Magpasya tayo ngayon: lumaban o umiwas.

translations.EN: We can take them.
translations.TL: Kaya natin sila.

translations.EN: I say we hit them before they spread out.
translations.TL: Sabi ko salubungin natin sila bago sila kumalat.

translations.EN: I'm with you. We can take them.
translations.TL: Kasama mo ako. Kaya natin sila.

translations.EN: Fuck yeah. We take them.
translations.TL: Oo, puta. Laban tayo.

translations.EN: Hell yeah. Hit them hard.
translations.TL: Sige. Todo ang tira natin.

translations.EN: If we commit, we hit hard and stay together.
translations.TL: Kung lalaban tayo, sabay at todo ang tira.

translations.EN: Too many. We should pull back.
translations.TL: Sobra sila. Dapat umatras tayo.

translations.EN: I don't like those numbers. Back off.
translations.TL: Hindi maganda ang dami nila. Umatras tayo.

translations.EN: I'd rather get us out of this alive. Pull back.
translations.TL: Mas gusto kong makaalis tayong buhay. Umatras tayo.

translations.EN: Fuck... too many. Back.
translations.TL: Puta... sobra sila. Umatras.

translations.EN: Nope. Too many. Move.
translations.TL: Hindi. Sobra sila. Alis.

translations.EN: Bad odds. Give them space.
translations.TL: Masama ang tsansa. Lumayo tayo.

translations.EN: Hold here. Don't rush it.
translations.TL: Dito muna. Huwag padalos-dalos.

translations.EN: Let's hold and read the situation first.
translations.TL: Humawak muna tayo at tingnan ang sitwasyon.

translations.EN: Stay together. Let's hold before we commit.
translations.TL: Magkakasama tayo. Humawak muna bago sumugod.

translations.EN: Hold. Watch them.
translations.TL: Hawak. Bantayan sila.

translations.EN: No rush. Hold position and watch the pressure.
translations.TL: Walang pagmamadali. Humawak at bantayan ang galaw nila.

translations.EN: I heard something worth passing on.
translations.TL: May narinig akong mahalagang ipasa sa iyo.

translations.EN: There is some news you should hear.
translations.TL: May balita kang dapat marinig.

translations.EN: I thought you should hear what I learned.
translations.TL: Naisip kong dapat mong marinig ang nalaman ko.

translations.EN: Got some news for you.
translations.TL: May balita ako para sa iyo.

translations.EN: I have something I can confirm.
translations.TL: May bagay akong makukumpirma.

translations.EN: That is what I can confirm right now.
translations.TL: Iyan ang makukumpirma ko sa ngayon.

translations.EN: That is everything I know for certain.
translations.TL: Iyan lang ang tiyak kong alam.

translations.EN: I wish I knew more, but that is what I can confirm.
translations.TL: Sana mas marami akong alam, pero iyan ang makukumpirma ko.

translations.EN: That is all I can confirm.
translations.TL: Iyan lang ang makukumpirma ko.

translations.EN: Nothing else I can verify yet.
translations.TL: Wala pa akong ibang mapapatunayan.

translations.EN: We're getting ready to head out.
translations.TL: Naghahanda na tayong umalis.

translations.EN: We're getting ready. Make sure you've got what you need.
translations.TL: Naghahanda na tayo. Siguraduhin mong dala mo ang kailangan mo.

translations.EN: Get ready. We leave soon.
translations.TL: Maghanda. Aalis tayo agad.

translations.EN: Prep first. We move when everyone's ready.
translations.TL: Maghanda muna. Aalis tayo kapag handa na ang lahat.

translations.EN: We're moving out. Keep close.
translations.TL: Aalis na tayo. Dumikit ka.

translations.EN: We're heading out. Stay close and we'll get through it.
translations.TL: Aalis na tayo. Dumikit ka at malalampasan natin ito.

translations.EN: Moving out. Stay close.
translations.TL: Aalis na. Dumikit.

translations.EN: We're outbound. Keep the group tight.
translations.TL: Papunta na tayo. Panatilihing dikit ang grupo.

translations.EN: We're heading home.
translations.TL: Pauwi na tayo.

translations.EN: Time to head home. Let's get everyone back safe.
translations.TL: Oras nang umuwi. Iuwi nating ligtas ang lahat.

translations.EN: Heading home.
translations.TL: Pauwi na.

translations.EN: We're returning. Stay alert until we're home.
translations.TL: Pabalik na tayo. Mag-ingat hanggang makauwi.

translations.EN: We're back. Good.
translations.TL: Nakabalik na tayo. Mabuti.

translations.EN: We're home. Good to have everyone back.
translations.TL: Nasa bahay na tayo. Mabuting nakabalik ang lahat.

translations.EN: Back home.
translations.TL: Nakauwi na.

translations.EN: We're back. Check in and settle down.
translations.TL: Nakabalik na tayo. Mag-check in at magpahinga.

translations.EN: Trip's off. Something went wrong.
translations.TL: Kanselado ang biyahe. May nangyaring mali.

translations.EN: We're calling it off. Better safe than forcing it.
translations.TL: Ititigil muna natin. Mas mabuting ligtas kaysa pilitin.

translations.EN: Trip's off.
translations.TL: Kanselado ang biyahe.

translations.EN: Excursion failed. We regroup here.
translations.TL: Bigo ang paglalakbay. Magtipon ulit tayo rito.

translations.EN: Zombies, {clock}!
translations.TL: Mga zombie, {clock}!

translations.EN: Zombies {relative}!
translations.TL: Mga zombie {relative}!

translations.EN: Hostiles at {clock}!
translations.TL: Mga kalaban sa {clock}!

translations.EN: Hostiles {relative}!
translations.TL: Mga kalaban {relative}!
